the applicant seeks to invoke the inherent powers of this Court praying for quashing of the FIR being C.R.No.I-42 of 2018 registered with Mithapur Police Station, District Devbhoomi Dwarka for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(F), 376(2)(N), 462, 468 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4, 5(L), 6, 8 and 12 of the POCSO Act and consequential proceedings, if any,

sentences.text: 1 3. Learned advocate Mr. Ansari, at the outset, submits that FIR is filed against total 7 accused persons and applicant stood at serial No.7.

Learned advocate Mr. Ansari further submits that so far as accused Nos. 1 to 6 are concerned, the matter is settled between the said accused persons and complainant and on the strength of the said settlement arrived at between them, the Coordinate Bench of this Court quashed the FIR qua accused Nos. 1 to 6 vide order dated 25.02.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Application No.9562 of 2019.
Learned advocate Mr. Ansari has produced a copy of the said order on record.
Learned advocate Mr. Ansari submits that so far as the role of the present applicant is concerned, he has abetted the main accused persons.

Learned advocate Mr. Ansari submits that when the proceedings qua main accused persons have already been quashed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court, the FIR and consequential proceedings, if any, based upon the said FIR may also be quashed qua applicant.
4. Learned APP Mr. Dhawan Jayswal submits that considering the facts of the present case, an appropriate order may be passed.

5. Having heard the learned advocates appearing for the parties and having gone through the material placed on record, it is found out that FIR is filed against total 7 accused persons, out of which, the FIR is quashed qua accused Nos. 1 to 6 by the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/16942/2018 ORDER DATED: 15/04/2024 undefined Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 25.02.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Application No.9562 of 2019.
Bare perusal of the above stated order makes it clear that the FIR qua accused Nos. 1 to 6 is quashed on the ground that the matter is settled between the parties.

It appears that the original complainant remained present before the Coordinate Bench of this Court and on the strength of the statement made by the complainant, the proceedings were quashed qua the accused Nos. 1 to 6.
In the aforesaid order, it is also mentioned that applicant No.6 and complainant got married and a certificate of registration of marriage also produced on record.

Thus, when the FIR and all consequential proceedings arising therefrom have been quashed qua the main accused persons, in the opinion of this Court,
continuation of further proceedings qua the applicant would be an exercise in futility.

6. In the result, the FIR being C.R.No.I-42 of 2018 registered with Mithapur Police Station, District Devbhoomi Dwarka and consequential proceedings, if any, arising out of the said FIR are hereby quashed qua the applicant.
